meta.units: degrees of view rotation; x = yaw (right +), y = pitch (up +)

monteCarlo.band: per-shot 10th and 90th percentile of the cumulative x and y independently (linear interpolation)

notes: pattern is RecoilPattern[n] as authored; shot n turns it by a uniform random angle in +-randomDeviationDeg; past the pattern (and for every shot of a weapon without one) yaw and pitch are uniform draws in postPattern (Weapons v2 section 5a, 0x6B95C50).

expectedPath and band sum the authored kicks for max(pattern length, 40) shots with no recovery (firearms have no self recovery); after the pattern the mean of the post-pattern ranges is used for the path.

multipliers.horizontal/vertical are the standing default-loadout Attribute.Gameplay.Weapon.*RecoilMultiplier values, stance.crouch/prone the vertical ratio to standing; the viewer applies them with viewKickMagnitudeMultiplier and focusReductionPct; paths and bands are not scaled by them.
Season 1 multipliers use the Season 2 effect values (assets/data/ge-values.json) on Season 1 item data.
rpm is RoundsPerMinute from the stats asset; where the asset omits it the constructor default 600 applies (rpmSource says which).
category: infantry | vehicle | stationary | test (test assets and stats assets no item links) | tool (Fists, BuildTool). nameSource none marks a weapon whose in-game name is not in the exported data.
changedS1toS2 lists the fields that differ between seasons (null when a season is absent); a weapon present in only one season has the other season null (s1) or present false (s2).
